title: fix(ui): align session header with sidebar controls
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes desktop web session and page headers sitting on different centerlines from sidebar buttons, Incognito, and collapsed navigation controls.

## User Impact

Desktop web headers and controls share one aligned row. Mobile drawers and native-window chrome retain their existing clearance and hit targets.

## Why This Change Was Made

Reuse the existing 48px rail-height token and center controls within that row. Scope sidebar, Incognito, and ordinary page-toolbar adjustments to desktop web. The ordinary page toolbar also needed the shared height: moving navigation controls alone left its title two pixels lower.

Existing browser assertions now protect the 24px centerline. Capture callers use the existing model-option reveal helper, the fixture's actual fast-mode control, and uniquely owned popover surfaces. No production menu behavior, tolerance, timeout, or screenshot helper was weakened.

## Evidence

- Published signed candidate: `157ae08d473b76af5176fe64b85f115cae08d3d5`, tree `46475b527545420c86c9ac7e5a1fcb3f92b95b16`.
- Retained causal Incognito reproduction failed for the intended 6px displacement against the existing 2px tolerance. A separate intermediate run exposed the ordinary page-toolbar mismatch (26px versus 24px); both original failed aggregates remain failed.
- [Final Testbox qualification](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36255552763): nine passing browser cases on the published candidate, explicit seven-path changed checks and diff-check passed, no suite or unhandled errors, and all 79 commands joined with source restored. The wrapper completed successfully; Actions cancellation during lease cleanup is not an application failure.
- [Retained compatible proof](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36254860535): one complete new-session capture case plus eight chat/mobile/clearance cases passed at `7064609659b8`. Their code paths are unchanged by the final non-chat page-toolbar repair. Combined evidence covers **18 distinct passing cases across revisions**, not 18 rerun at the final head.
- Chromium exercised the isolated mock Gateway, desktop expanded/collapsed navigation, mobile clearance, RTL page headers, and native-host CSS modes. This is not physical native-app proof.
- Fresh full-candidate independent review found no actionable P0-P2 findings. The upstream scroll-pane fixture repair is inherited from [91ee6aa](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/91ee6aa3de1072401b2ff6eb2dd724c276061dbc), not authored by this PR.
- All four fresh header crops below are embedded in this PR and verified by anonymous HTTP 200 responses, PNG content and exact inspected-file hashes. They were also inspected and delivered in the review conversation. Original session-header captures remain preserved.
- Measured single-worker remote command walls: complete new-session case 20.400s (four other cases filtered); final page-toolbar case 16.729s (eight compatible cases retained); native page-header suite 19.753s (six cases); native-chrome selection 24.200s (two cases). The earlier whole clearance file took 44.725s with eight passes and the now-repaired header failure. These are observed command costs including runner overhead, not speedup claims; no new test case was added.

### Current Readiness

Merged by native squash as [c32d26f3e204](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/c32d26f3e204c0acd423e52e47bd60b9aa4c9e0b). [Exact-head CI](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/36256300869) passed: 29 successful jobs and 22 intentional skips, including all nine UI E2E shards. Those existing CI shards took 264-471 seconds each; that is whole-shard wall time, not this patch's incremental cost. [Fresh ClawSweeper review](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/156432#issuecomment-5793233175) completed with no actionable findings or before-merge items. Its unavailable page-header media observation is covered by the independently inspected, publicly served and hash-verified captures above. Native hosted gates, exact-head preparation, squash receipt and cleanup completed; all seven landed file blobs match the reviewed candidate.

Historical [CI35848500390](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/35848500390) failed at `deec1f2cd581`. The new focused proof does not retroactively exonerate that run or attribute every historical dependency failure.
